from pathlib import Path
import csv, json, hashlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, shutil, time, io, re
base=Path('products/services/catalogue-qa')
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

reference=json.loads((base/'fixed-price-trial/director-byte-isolated-control.json').read_text())
answer=(base/'fixed-price-trial/buyer-report-isolated-control.md').read_text()
sources=[base/'fulfillment'/name for name in ('synthetic-v.csv','synthetic-i.csv','synthetic-ours.csv')]
expected,observed=[run['sha256'] for run in reference['runs']]
clean=sources[2].read_bytes()
assert sha(clean)==expected
old=b'https://example.com/img/SYN-B-Blue-1.jpg'
new=b'https://example.invalid/fictional-variant.png'
lines=clean.splitlines(keepends=True)
assert len(lines)==21 and b'SYN-B-BL-XXL' in lines[20] and old in lines[20]
lines[20]=lines[20].replace(b'0000000000020',b'0000000000000',1).replace(old,new,1)
modified=b''.join(lines)
assert sha(modified)==observed
names=('variants','images','produced')
intake=b'Please check the produced rows against the source catalogue. This is fictional data.\n'
for name,data in zip(names,(sources[0].read_bytes(),sources[1].read_bytes(),modified)):
    assert data.endswith(b'\n')
    intake+=f'BEGIN {name}\n'.encode()+data+f'END {name}\n'.encode()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    directory=Path(temp)
    for name in ('transform.py','verify.py','verify_example.py'):
        shutil.copyfile(base/'runtime'/name,directory/name)
    start=time.perf_counter()
    blocks=re.findall(rb'^BEGIN (\w+)\n(.*?)^END \1\n',intake,re.M|re.S)
    assert [name.decode() for name,_ in blocks]==list(names)
    for name,contents in blocks:
        (directory/(name.decode()+'.csv')).write_bytes(contents)
    extracted=time.perf_counter()
    command=[sys.executable,'verify_example.py',*(n+'.csv' for n in names)]
    result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=temp,text=True,capture_output=True)
    report=json.loads(result.stdout)
    verified=time.perf_counter()
    def records(data):
        rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data.decode())))
        sku={row['SKU']:(index,row) for index,row in enumerate(rows,1) if row['SKU']}
        assert len(sku)==sum(bool(row['SKU']) for row in rows)
        return sku
    baseline=records(clean)
    candidate=records((directory/'produced.csv').read_bytes())
    assert baseline.keys()==candidate.keys()
    findings=[]
    for sku,(index,row) in candidate.items():
        _,prior=baseline[sku]
        for field in ('Barcodes','Variant image URL'):
            if row[field]!=prior[field]:
                findings.append(dict(sku=sku,record=index,field=field,expected=prior[field],observed=row[field]))
    located=time.perf_counter()
    message='Catalogue QA report for a fictional buyer\n\n'
    message+='Autonomous AI agents prepared this report. I checked '+str(report['rows'])+' produced variant records against the documented CSV column subset. The verifier flagged identifier preservation and variant image mapping. A separate comparison by SKU located these changes.\n\n'
    for item in findings:
        message+='- {sku}, data record {record} after the header, {field}. Expected {expected}. Found {observed}.\n'.format(**item)
    message+='\nRestore those values in the produced CSV and rerun the check before import. Shopify import was outside the scope of this check. Preservation and image mapping require produced rows. Source rows alone support input validation.\n'
    dest=base/'timed-delivery'
    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (dest/'inline-response.md').write_text(message)
    drafted=time.perf_counter()
    assert result.returncode==reference['runs'][1]['exit']==1
    assert report['failed']==reference['runs'][1]['failed_checks'] and report['rows']==20
    assert findings==reference['changes']
    assert all(str(item[key]) in answer for item in findings for key in ('sku','record','expected','observed'))
    assert (dest/'inline-response.md').read_text()==message
    reviewed=time.perf_counter()
    elapsed=reviewed-start
    metrics=dict(synthetic=True,answer_key_task='TASK-179585850100',input_sha256=sha(intake),produced_sha256=observed,command=command,exit=result.returncode,stdout=report,stderr=result.stderr,findings=findings,answer_key_match=True,seconds=dict(extraction=extracted-start,verification=verified-extracted,row_location=located-verified,response_render_and_write=drafted-located,automated_review=reviewed-drafted,total=elapsed,workflow_design=None,independent_review=None,customer_revisions=None,administration=None),hypothetical_hourly_rate_cad=60,provisional_price_cad=60,remaining_minutes_before_deductions_and_unmeasured_effort=60-elapsed/60,decision='Keep provisional scope only. This rehearsal times scripted execution and response rendering. It excludes workflow design, independent review, revisions, administration and deductions.     (dest/'rehearsal.json').write_text(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2))
